news.headline: Wall Street slides: Nasdaq -2.6%, S&P -1.2% on AI-stock rout
news.what_happened: Nasdaq had its worst session since June and the S&P 500 its worst since July as AI-linked names (Nvidia, Meta) sold off. Nikkei fell 2.1%, Hang Seng 0.5%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off global tone and weak Nasdaq are negative for Indian IT valuations and FII appetite; defensives hold up better.

news.headline: Brent near $113-114, WTI ~$100 on Iran war
news.what_happened: Crude extended gains, with Brent at its highest since May on Iran-war supply fears.
news.why_it_matters: Negative for India's import bill, INR and crude-sensitive users (airlines, paints, tyres, FMCG); supportive for upstream producers.

news.headline: US 10Y yield falls to ~4.95% as investors seek safety
news.what_happened: Treasuries rallied (yield down from ~5.15%) alongside the equity sell-off; gold slipped 0.75% and DXY was flat.
news.why_it_matters: Easing yields are a small relief for banks and rate-sensitives but the flight to safety dominates sentiment.

news.headline: Nifty closed 22,688 (-0.88%) on prior session
news.what_happened: Nifty 50 fell 0.88% in the last session; HDFCBANK, RELIANCE and IT names were weak.
news.why_it_matters: Weak global cues point to a soft start; GIFT Nifty and FII/DII data could not be verified this morning.

sector_outlook.reason: Weak global tone offset by falling US yields
